subject: [PATCH v2 01/11] nfsd: don't hold inode_lock while waiting for a delegation in nfsd_setattr()

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFS server where it waits for a delegation to be returned while holding the inode lock, causing a deadlock when the holder sends data before returning the delegation. The patch drops the inode lock during the wait and restarts the setattr operation if necessary, ensuring that the file system remains consistent.
